values.binNote: Derived by dividing the Total Heal (SorakaQ.BaseHoT / SorakaQ.HealAPRatio) by the 12 ticks stated in the notes; no separate per-tick data value exists in the bin.
The bin has no explicit tick-interval data value; 0.2 is derived from the wiki's stated 12 ticks over the 2.5s HotDuration (2.5/12 ≈ 0.2083, rounded to 0.2 by the wiki).

mechanics.claim: Starcall lands after a delay based on distance, not instantly on cast.
mechanics.quote: grants sight of the area before landing after {{pp|type=target range|0.25 to 1 for 16|50 to 800}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Hitting a spell shield still counts as a hit for granting Rejuvenation.
mechanics.quote: ''Starcall'' counts as hitting even if it gets blocked by {{tip|spell shield}}, granting ''Rejuvenation''.

mechanics.claim: Rejuvenation is only granted to Soraka if the cast hits at least one enemy champion.
mechanics.quote: If this hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}}, star dust returns to '''Soraka''', granting her ''Rejuvenation'' for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: Rejuvenation's heal-over-time is split into 12 ticks with uneven weighting across the duration.
mechanics.quote: ''Rejuvenation'' heals over 12 ticks, with the first 4 each healing for about 15% of the heal, the next 4 ticks for about {{fd|5.5}}% each, and the last 4 for about {{fd|4.5}}% each.
